title: Pesticide residues on food and the Dirty Dozen
summary: Dietitian-parent clip saying residues on food are far too small to affect health and the Dirty Dozen omits which pesticides and at what level.

assertions.quote: the residue that remains on our food are in levels of such small quantities that they don't have an impact on our health
what it doesn't do is identify what that pesticide is and whether or not it's found at a level that would impact health
